title: Camping diary
text:
Friday, 5 pm
We arrived at the campsite by the lake. Dad put up the big blue tent, and I helped to hammer in the pegs. My brother Eko blew up the air beds. The lake was calm and shiny like a mirror.

Friday, 8 pm
We cooked rice and sausages on a small stove. Then we sat around the fire and listened to the frogs. Dad said the sky had more stars than he had ever seen. I counted a hundred and then lost count.

Saturday, 7 am
I woke up early because a bird was singing right above the tent. The air felt cool and smelt of wet grass. Mum made hot chocolate. After breakfast we paddled a small boat across the lake. Eko tried to catch a fish with his hands, but he fell in! Everyone laughed, even Eko.

Saturday, 6 pm
It is time to go home. I am tired, but I have never been so happy. I want to come back next year.
